---
title: Dashboard
format: dashboard
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load 2024 results from your earlier file
sov_clean <- read_csv("data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")

# Build two-party totals per precinct
sov_cong <- sov_clean |>
  mutate(
    DEM = rowSums(across(starts_with("CNGDEM")), na.rm = TRUE),
    REP = rowSums(across(starts_with("CNGREP")), na.rm = TRUE),
    TOTAL = DEM + REP
  ) |>
  filter(TOTAL > 0)

# Aggregate by 2024 districts
district_votes_2024 <- sov_cong |>
  group_by(CDDIST) |>
  summarize(
    DEM = sum(DEM),
    REP = sum(REP)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    TOTAL = DEM + REP,
    DEM_SHARE = DEM / TOTAL
  )

# Mean–median difference 2024
mm_2024 <- mean(district_votes_2024$DEM_SHARE) -
           median(district_votes_2024$DEM_SHARE)

# Load the fake 2025 map results (created in data-cleaning.qmd)
district_votes_2025 <- read_csv("data/district_votes_2025.csv") |>
  mutate(DEM_SHARE = DEM / TOTAL)

mm_2025 <- mean(district_votes_2025$DEM_SHARE) -
           median(district_votes_2025$DEM_SHARE)
